name: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
summary: GOLD-SLAM integrates panoramic Gaussian splatting with LiDAR depth priors for omnidirectional SLAM, improving pose estimation and geometric reconstruction while maintaining competitive rendering quality.
